title: Which Sam does each paper mean?
what_we_know: The 1940 notice is signed SAM CALICURA. The qualification record names Sam Calicura of 726 Ferry Street as employer. The Gazette puts "Sam" at 731 and then 515 Mellus.
what_we_dont: Which of the family's Sams each paper means.
evidence_needed: An address or relation that ties each paper to one man.
